needed.evidence: No footway visible, pedestrians walking in the roadway
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide safe pedestrian access.

needed.evidence: Informal path under 1m wide and partly blocked by market stalls
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated, unobstructed sidewalk on the right side to ensure safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the informal path
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the informal path on the right side to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians crossing the carriageway without a crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with refuge islands to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting along the urban road
needed.suggestion: Add more street lights to ensure adequate illumination for both vehicles and pedestrians.
